renders._yaml:
- component: advanced_viz
  id: stacked_taxonomy
  title: Taxonomic composition per sample
  description: |-
    Each bar is a sample, split into the relative abundance of its most abundant clades at the chosen taxonomic rank, with the rest lumped as Other. It answers which organisms make up each metagenome and how the samples compare.
    How to read: samples with similar bars share a community, and a sample dominated by one taxon is a low-diversity or perturbed community. Switch the rank from kingdom to species to move between the overview and the detail.
    Note: MetaPhlAn reports relative abundance among the clades it detects, so the bars show composition and not absolute counts.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/biobakery/MetaPhlAn/master/README.md and https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36823356/
  kind: stacked_bar
  config:
    top_n: 10
    x_title: Sample
    value_title: Relative abundance (%)
  roles:
    sample_id: sample_id
    taxon: taxon
    rank: rank
    abundance: relative_abundance

- component: table
  title: Taxonomic profile
  description: |-
    Each row is a clade in a sample with its rank, its relative abundance and its NCBI taxonomy identifier. It answers the exact abundance behind the composition bars.
    How to read: filter by rank, sort by relative abundance and open a taxon's taxonomy identifier to look it up.
